texto: Pay attention to the conditions: which documents are required, how the documentation should be sent (copy versus original) and according to what criteria a partial refund is calculated.
Watch the formal processing lexicon: **rimborso**, **pratica**, **ricevuta**, **tratta non percorsa**.

frases.it: Gentile cliente, abbiamo ricevuto la sua richiesta di rimborso per il biglietto ferroviario.
frases.es: Estimado cliente, hemos recibido su solicitud de reembolso para el billete ferroviario.
frases.en: Dear customer, we have received your request for reimbursement for the railway ticket.

frases.it: Per completare la pratica, invii entro cinque giorni una copia del biglietto e la ricevuta del pagamento.
frases.es: Para completar el trámite, envíe en el plazo de cinco días una copia del billete y el recibo del pago.
frases.en: To complete the procedure, send within five days a copy of the ticket and the receipt of the payment.
analisis: and the receipt of the payment

frases.it: Non occorre spedire i documenti originali per posta ordinaria.
frases.es: No es necesario enviar los documentos originales por correo ordinario.
frases.en: It is not necessary to send the original documents by ordinary mail.

frases.it: La somma sarà restituita sul conto usato per l'acquisto entro quindici giorni lavorativi.
frases.es: El importe será devuelto a la cuenta utilizada para la compra en el plazo de quince días laborables.
frases.en: The amount shall be returned to the account used for purchase within 15 working days.
analisis: to the account used for the purchase

frases.it: Se il viaggio è stato effettuato solo in parte, l'importo verrà calcolato in base alla tratta non percorsa.
frases.es: Si el viaje se realizó solo en parte, el importe se calculará en base al trayecto no recorrido.
frases.en: If the trip was only partially carried out, the amount shall be calculated on the basis of the untravelled journey.
analisis: se il viaggio è stato effettuato
if the trip was carried out
in base alla tratta non percorsa
on the basis of the untraveled journey

bloques.pregunta: What management has the customer requested from the transport company?

opciones.texto: The financial refund for a train ticket.
opciones.explicacion: The letter begins by confirming: «abbiamo ricevuto la sua richiesta di rimborso per il biglietto ferroviario».

opciones.texto: A change of date to travel for the next weekend.
opciones.explicacion: He does not ask to change the reservation but to recover the money from the trip.

opciones.texto: A compensation for miscarrying your suitcase at the station.
opciones.explicacion: The claim concerns only the price of the railway ticket.

bloques.pregunta: What documentation should the user submit to complete the file?

opciones.texto: A legible copy of the purchased ticket along with the payment voucher.
opciones.explicacion: The text clearly indicates: «una copia del biglietto e la ricevuta del pagamento».

opciones.texto: The original notes sealed by a notary at the central station.
opciones.explicacion: It is expressly clarified that original documents are not required.

opciones.texto: The contract of employment and a medical certificate of emergency.
opciones.explicacion: Only commercial supporting documents are required for the purchase of the ticket.

bloques.pregunta: What time limit is available to the traveller to forward the requested vouchers?

opciones.texto: Not more than five days from the date of notification.
opciones.explicacion: The instruction states: «invii entro cinque giorni».

opciones.texto: For a period of 15 working days without a deadline.
opciones.explicacion: Fifteen working days is the time the company is reserved to enter the money.

opciones.texto: From two full months until the end of the winter season.
opciones.explicacion: The procedure requires the diligent dispatch in five days.

bloques.pregunta: Why should the approved amount be returned?

opciones.texto: By direct subscription to the same account used when making the purchase.
opciones.explicacion: «sul conto usato per l'acquisto» shall be paid.

opciones.texto: In cash at any railway locker in the country.
opciones.explicacion: It is not paid in a physical window but by digital banking.

opciones.texto: By means of a discount bonus, you can exchange only in train cafes.
opciones.explicacion: The full money is returned to the home account.

bloques.pregunta: How is the amount to be returned determined if the passenger completed a part of the journey?

opciones.texto: Se liquida proporcionalmente la cantidad correspondiente al tramo no recorrido.
opciones.explicacion: The text states: «l'importo verrà calcolato in base alla tratta non percorsa».

opciones.texto: Se deniega automáticamente el derecho a cualquier compensación económica.
opciones.explicacion: It expressly provides for the payment of the proportion not enjoyed.

opciones.texto: The price of a first-class ticket is reimbursed for another trip.
opciones.explicacion: The calculation is strictly in line with the untraveled kilometres.

bloques.pregunta: What does this administrative clarification mean?
bloques.frase: Non occorre spedire i documenti originali per posta ordinaria.

opciones.texto: That it is enough to provide digital copies without having to get rid of the physical originals.
opciones.explicacion: «Non occorre» exempts the user from sending original paper via postal.

opciones.texto: That ordinary mail correspondence is the only way to claim.
opciones.explicacion: It points out exactly the opposite: there is no need to use the ordinary mail.

opciones.texto: That the original documents are not legally valid for reimbursement.
opciones.explicacion: The originals are valid, but copies are enough to speed up the file.

opciones.explicacion: feminine singular-concorded Participle with the «la somma» subject.

opciones.explicacion: It is the infinitive without conjugating in passive voice.
